_about: Taxonomy for conference / festival / community-event recap videos: stage, crowd, booths, food, activities. Used by the tagging prompts, the matcher and the storyboard. Copy into storyboard_project.json 'taxonomy' (as {"preset": "event_recap", ...overrides}) to change it for one project.

categories.stage_music: band / singers / music or performance on a stage
categories.speaker_stage: someone speaking or presenting on a stage
categories.crowd_audience: the audience or a crowd (seated, standing, cheering, hands up)
categories.hallway_walking: people walking through halls, lobbies, entrances
categories.interview_talking_head: a person talking to the camera / interview framing
categories.food_market: food, food trucks, market stalls, eating
categories.closeup_detail: close-up of hands, objects, merch, details
categories.signage_text: signs, banners, screens with readable text

subject_hint: raw footage of a live event (conference, festival, show, community gathering)
